newsitem.title: USA: Katz Digital to acquire N.Y. firm.
newsitem.headline: Katz Digital to acquire N.Y. firm.

text.p: Katz Digital Technologies Inc said Monday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Advanced Digital Services Inc.

Katz did not disclose terms of the deal, which it said was subject to the signing of definitive agreement. It said it expects the deal to close within 90 days, subject to due diligence and the receipt required consents and other approvals, it said.
Advanced Digital provides pre-press services to advertising agencies, publishers and major corporations. It is based in Manhattan, N.Y.
